dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: How are you feeling? Getting used to the style of combat here?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I gotta say, I'm growing to like this place. There are fun surprises everywhere, and it just feels free of any stress or tension.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Let's take a short break, then dive in to the next challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: What a wondrous place this is... You never know what the next challenge is gonna throw at you, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hmm? I sound excited? Well, yeah. I mean, seeking out challenges is pretty much my main hobby.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: This place is like paradise to me. I'm really enjoying my time here.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It seems like everything that happens here gets recorded in the form of a play.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: But who is behind all of this? Someone passionate about records and legacy, I guess?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Anyway, I like the fact that the records are available to view any time. It'll be interesting to look back on them in the future, and see what hindsight brings to the equation.
